note: The built core combines this repository's integration (GPL-2.0-or-later: the driver, the headless platform layer, the patches) with dsda-doom (GPL-2.0-or-later), compiled in from the submodule extern/dsda-doom (github.com/kraflab/dsda-doom, based on PrBoom+ and Doom's source release), and zlib (the zlib licence), which inflates ZDoom's compressed nodes. The package's assets/dsda-doom.wad is dsda-doom's own data, built from its sources (prboom2/data) with its rdatawad tool, under the same licence. Mesa's OpenGL headers (MIT) are read by the compiler for declarations only; no OpenGL code is in the core. The package carries none of the games' data: the IWADs and PWADs are the project's, supplied by the user.
